source: Written by hand from 02-product-spec.md J11 (table, AC11.1 to AC11.3, AC11.12) and 05-ai-design.md section 6. GEMINI_SAFETY_BLOCKED replaces VERTEX_SAFETY_BLOCKED per the tech-lead decision recorded in ARC-M2-05 (carry-over 2).

router.rule: J11: no tool runs. The turn fails with the mapped code; nothing from Gemini is shown. Every attempt that reached Vertex AI counts.

cap_reached.rule: J11: checked before any model call, so no call is made; typed messages are blocked.

extraction.rule: J11: order read, no review stored.

explanation.rule: J11 and J1 'Explanation fails twice': the numbers are kept, and the text is the code-written attribution summary, never Gemini text.

writer.rule: J11 and AC11.2: the template answer is shown with no error message, and the turn counts exactly 2 attempts.

cap_reached.rule: 05 section 6: GEMINI_DAILY_CAP_EXCEEDED with BUDGET_SESSION_EXHAUSTED. The writer reservation is denied, so only the router attempt counts.
